_readme: Second own-site map read at Los Angeles Mission College (S346, SkyCairn). Its mapper (la-mission.programmapper.ws) answered 403 on 2026-10-08 (S345). A domain-restricted search (2026-10-08) found the Arts, Media and Performance pathway page, which links a 'Painting AA Program Map' and a 'Studio Arts AAT Program Map'. This read loads that page, prints the map links, and follows them where they stay off the mapper host (the reader skips a host the procedure marks refused).

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map off its refused mapper host, and in what form.
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses.
